=== Missing data ===
* Not added: that he was from Palm Beach, Florida (only an AIM-profile link to Palm Beach weather is quoted; private detail).
* Not added: that Neal Razi was a close personal friend (private life), from the same October 2004 post.
* Not added: his plan to talk to "Neal" about the DeckTech rating system (first name only).
* The Salem-area venue (Harrison's Comics) named in the fact list is not in his post 40087; only his offer to direct tournaments for eastern Massachusetts players is used.

=== Possibly faulty data ===
* The Playtest Committee recommendation is his own statement in a heated thread (October 2004); it is written as what he wrote.
